summary: Ninety days of uptime per service as pixel columns swept in on load; hovering a day lifts that column across all services.

attributes.name: data
attributes.description: Daily uptime records, oldest first: percentages or `{ service, date, uptime, status, note }` records (`date` as an ISO string or epoch ms, `uptime` in percent, `status` one of `ok`, `degraded`, `down`). Records with the same `service` form one row; without `service` they share a row named `Uptime`. Observed: changing it redraws. Without it the element shows demo data.

properties.name: data
properties.description: The same records as the `data` attribute, without JSON. Setting it redraws; `null` returns to the demo data. Reading it returns your records as normalised objects, grouped per service, or `null`.

accessibility: The canvas has `role="img"`. Its `aria-label` lists the shown days and each service's uptime, e.g. `Uptime for the last 30 days: API 99.95%, Console 100.00%`, for your data and for the demo.
Per-day details appear in a tooltip on pointer hover only; there is no keyboard access to individual days.
motion: With reduced motion, all columns appear at once instead of sweeping in from the left.
notes: Each service row shows its average uptime over the shown days, computed from the `uptime` values; days without `uptime` are left out of the average, and a row without any shows a dash.
Without `status`, a day's status follows from `uptime`: 99.9% or more is ok, 99% or more degraded, below that down. A record with neither is drawn as a day without data.

Services with fewer days than the longest one are aligned to the right, so the latest days share a column. Dates label the ends and the tooltip; without dates the days count back from today. An empty array shows `No data`.
The tooltip shows the date, the service, the status, the uptime and your `note`. The demo shows invented services (API, Console, Workflows), statuses and incident durations.
Each day is 5px wide, so narrow containers show fewer days (the demo at most 90); the left label states the actual count or the first date.
Each service row is 56px tall; the demo canvas is 168px tall.

data.note: Pass your daily uptime records per service as `data`. Without it the element shows demo services and statuses.
